[EN] Mission Orders

We must take out the rest of the heretical sikandaris and secure the Temple of Sikander.

You are to kill sikandari {@LinkCreature:57#7#defenders}, {@LinkCreature:57#8#lifebringers}, and {@LinkCreature:57#10#champions}.

Report to Emya in Dragonfall when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Debemos eliminar al resto de los sikandaris heréticos y asegurar el Temple of Sikander.

Debes matar sikandari {@LinkCreature:57#7#defenders}, {@LinkCreature:57#8#lifebringers}, y {@LinkCreature:57#10#champions}.

Preséntate ante Emya en Dragonfall cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
